items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: Fulcher arranged for the then mayor, Jim Reese, in 1972, also a jazz fan at our parties, and he had reached -- swear me in

ctx.x: And he presented the whole group at that particular time, with silver western buckels and everybody got a western rancher's dress Stetson hat. I think that particular party we were on, about 15 people -- this little party was going at the time, and I still have the Stetson, and I've put that thing under hot water and I've reshaped it, and around the crown I've got some Mexican silver doodads -- and I still wear it everyplace. All over the world, in fact. To Europe and Switzerland and so forth. I don't know…

And the next few years -- to continue in this vein -- Fulcher arranged for the then mayor, Jim Reese, in 1972, also a jazz fan at our parties, and he had reached -- swear me in and made me an official honorary citizen of Odessa, Texas. That's hanging here on the wall. And he did that so

I could be - and did become eventually as a citizen, I could legitimately recieve a regular commission in the sheriff's department of Ector County, Texas - and he set that up for me -- one of the bright happy lights in my life.
